David Whittlinger, Executive Director, New York eHealth Collaborative. Prior to working with NYeC, served as the Director of Healthcare Device Standards and Interoperability for the Intel Corporation in its Digital Health Group. Mr. Whitlinger was responsible for Intel's healthcare device interoperability strategies and standards development. He has also led a large, cross-industry consortium, the Continua Health Alliance, focused on the establishment of an
ecosystem of interoperable, personal telehealth systems. Prior to establishing the Healthcare Device Standards Group, he worked on a wide variety of wireless standards within Intel.
